brief: Retatrutide: The Trial Results Are Real. The Online Certainty Is Not.
method: Live PubMed E-utilities, Crossref, ClinicalTrials.gov v2, openFDA, and sponsor investor-newsroom verification on 2026-07-31 by an independent subagent plus direct re-checks. Conference/press-release items are labeled as such and are not treated as peer-reviewed publications.

sources.evidence_level: Phase 2 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled adult obesity trial
claims: 48-week body-weight change -24.2% at 12 mg vs -2.1% placebo
trials test the molecule, not individual receptor contributions
trial titration is not evidence for informal microdosing
sources.verification_note: Re-verified 2026-07-31: title, authors, journal, year, and all numbers reproduce exactly in PubMed/Crossref records.

sources.evidence_level: Phase 2 randomized, double-blind, placebo- and active-controlled adult type-2-diabetes trial
claims: HbA1c change -2.02 pp at week 24 (12-mg escalation)

sources.evidence_level: Phase 3 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled adult type-2-diabetes monotherapy trial
claims: 40-week HbA1c change -1.94 pp at 12 mg vs -0.81 pp placebo
GI events most frequent, generally mild-to-moderate
sources.verification_note: Re-verified 2026-07-31. Lancet 2026;407:2402-2413. Treatment-regimen estimand; 2 deaths in 4-mg arm deemed unrelated.

sources.evidence_level: Prespecified DXA substudy of a phase 2 randomized adult type-2-diabetes trial
claims: total fat-mass -23.2% (12 mg) vs -4.5% placebo at week 36
lean-mass-loss proportion similar to other obesity treatments
does not show lean mass preserved or muscle questions solved

sources.evidence_level: Phase 3 conference/press-release disclosure (ADA Scientific Sessions, 6 June 2026); not peer-reviewed, not posted to ClinicalTrials.gov
claims: 80-week mean weight change -28.3% (-70.3 lb) at 12 mg
knee-OA pain and sleep-apnea event reductions reported
sources.verification_note: URL verified via investor.lilly.com newsroom search; trial NCT05929066 COMPLETED 2026-04-06, hasResults=false. Labeled conference/press disclosure, not peer-reviewed.

sources.evidence_level: Phase 3 top-line press-release disclosures (23 July 2026); not peer-reviewed, not posted to ClinicalTrials.gov
claims: TRIUMPH-2: -20.8% at 12 mg vs -4.0% placebo (80 wk, obesity+T2D)
TRIUMPH-3: -22.6% at 12 mg vs -3.2% placebo (severe obesity+CVD)
sources.verification_note: URL verified via investor.lilly.com; TRIUMPH-2 NCT05929079 COMPLETED 2026-06-16, TRIUMPH-3 NCT05882045 COMPLETED 2026-04-16, both hasResults=false.

claims: results published in Lancet but not posted to registry (hasResults=false)

sources.evidence_level: Trial registrations (TRIUMPH-6 maintenance; NCT07357415 TRIUMPH-9 dose escalation)
sources.verification_note: Verified via ClinicalTrials.gov v2 on 2026-07-31. Reference entry covers both NCTs.
Verified via Lilly investor newsroom and Q2-2026 earnings disclosure; BLA planned Q1 2027.

claims: no adolescent retatrutide trial results identified
sources.verification_note: ClinicalTrials.gov retatrutide records checked 2026-07-31; no adolescent phase-3 results. Media reports of minors using unapproved product are reports of an unapproved market, not trial evidence.
